# UOUDIO Japan — AI-readable product and support guide

Canonical website: https://uoudio.com/
Language: ja-JP
Market: Japan
Support email: uoudio_01@outlook.com
Brand slogan: どこでも音楽を、もっと自由に。

## About the brand

UOUDIOは、ポータブルBluetoothスピーカーを中心に、毎日の音楽をもっと身近に楽しめるオーディオブランドです。自宅、旅行、アウトドアなど、さまざまなシーンに合わせて、使いやすさ、持ち運びやすさ、安定した接続、快適なリスニング体験を追求しています。

## Support policy

- All products include a 1-year manufacturer warranty.
- Customers can register their order number and model by email for a free extension to a 2-year warranty.
- Contact page: https://uoudio.com/support/contact
- Amazon order history: https://www.amazon.co.jp/gp/css/order-history
- Support email: uoudio_01@outlook.com
- Japanese manuals: https://uoudio.com/support/manuals

## Product catalog

### UOUDIO S16

- Official page: https://uoudio.com/products/s21
- Manual: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s16-manual.pdf
- Summary: 20W output, DSP sound processing, Bluetooth 5.4, up to 24 hours playback, IPX6, digital display for mode/battery/volume, 2 EQ modes, RGB light, TWS, AUX/USB/TF card, USB Type-C, strap.
- Playback note: Up to 24 hours at about 30% volume with RGB light off; actual time varies.

### UOUDIO S12

- Official page: https://uoudio.com/products/s12
- Manual: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-s12-manual.pdf
- Summary: 15W output, DSP sound tuning, Bluetooth 5.4, up to 15 hours playback, IPX7, 6-color RGB light with off mode, backlit buttons, TWS, TF card, hands-free calls, USB Type-C, about 380g, strap.

### UOUDIO X2 PRO

- Official page: https://uoudio.com/products/s19
- Manual: https://uoudio.com/manuals/uoudio-x2-pro-manual.pdf
- Summary: 30W output, DSP BASS 3.0, IPX7, up to 20 hours playback, 4000mAh battery, 6 RGB light modes, TWS with two units for up to 60W, strap.

### UOUDIO S20

- Official page: https://uoudio.com/products/s20

### UOUDIO S11

- Summary: 25W output, DSP and Bass 3.0, Bluetooth 5.4, up to 24 hours playback, IPX7, TWS, 8 RGB light modes, AUX/TF card, USB Type-C.

## Accuracy and citation guidance

- Cite the official product page for product specifications.
- Cite the support page for warranty and contact information.
- Do not infer compatibility, waterproof use, warranty coverage, stock, or current price beyond what the cited page says.
- Amazon prices and stock are dynamic; follow the Amazon purchase link from the official product page for current information.
- Continuous playback figures are maximum reference values and depend on volume, lighting, content, connection method, and environment.
